title.auto: Changes left on {{branch}} when switching branches
title.detached: Changes stashed on a detached HEAD

detail.auto: Garam stashed these when you switched branches.

actions.popHint: Bring the changes back and remove them from the stash list
actions.applyHint: Bring the changes back and keep them in the stash list

push.title: Stash Changes
push.body: Put your uncommitted changes aside (stash them) and return the working folder to the last commit. You can bring them back any time.
push.bodyFiles_one: Put aside only the changes to {{name}} and return that file to the last commit.
push.bodyFiles_other: Put aside only the changes to {{count}} files and return those files to the last commit.

drop.title: Discard stashed changes?
drop.body: “{{title}}” will be removed from the stash list. Right after, you can undo it from the notice.

branch.title: Create a Branch from Stashed Changes
branch.body: Creates a branch at the commit the changes were stashed on, switches to it and restores the changes there. Nothing that changed since gets in the way, so there are no conflicts.
branch.name: Branch name

done.applied: Stashed changes applied. They're still in the stash list.
done.unstaged: The changes are back, but which of them were included in the commit couldn't be restored. None are included now.
done.branched: Created {{branch}} and restored the changes there.

conflict.title: Restoring stashed changes ran into conflicts
conflict.body: Resolve the conflicted files. The stashed changes are still in the stash list.
conflict.resolvedBody: “{{title}}” is still in the stash list. Discard it if you no longer need it.
